title: 第5章 炎崧身殒
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“能解决吗？”

云澈对千叶影儿问出这一个问题。

千叶影儿没有说话，手持一道黑色玄光。

一道道黑色玄光击打在那些男子的身躯之上。

那些男子在这一道道黑色玄光击打下，纷纷的倒退。

叶家众位长老看到这一幕，他们都有些震惊了。

他们无法理解千叶影儿的力量究竟是达到了何等的地步。

千叶影儿只有区区的神主境十级，却可以在如此多的神主境围攻之下将这些神主境之人打到如此地步。

换作是他们，绝不可能做到这件事情。

云澈轻轻的点头，金色梵光，千叶影儿在深渊之中万不可动用。

千叶影儿也仅仅可以动用出黑暗玄力，这也导致她实力的大幅度的削减。

只不过，她体内拥有着劫天魔血，在动用出黑暗玄力之上比黑暗玄者不知强大多少倍。

就算她无法动用出梵光，也拥有着不俗实力。

“这…”

炎崧发出一道震惊的声音，他的眼睛也在此时看直了。

万万没想到，千叶影儿的实力能够达到如此地步。

“神君境。”

炎崧很快收回了自己的目光，将目光看向了云澈。

云澈只是一位神君，他先行解决云澈这位神君境之人，再行解决千叶影儿。

“来了。”

云澈嘴角微微扬起，很快就消失不见，是一道令炎崧无法察觉到的弧度。

炎崧看着云澈，五指成爪抓向他：

“今日，我先取你性命。”

云澈开启阎皇，拿出了劫天诛魔剑，劫天诛魔剑轻轻的斩出。

炎崧的手掌与劫天诛魔剑触碰在一起。

一道道炎光从他手掌之上倾泻而出，射向了云澈。

云澈动用出黑暗玄力，黑暗玄力将他周身笼罩，炎光接触到黑暗玄力刹那间，被黑暗玄力近乎无情的吞噬。

叶青：？？？

他目光一直在看着云澈，面对云澈爆发出如此强悍的力量，他对于云澈只能说出两个字：

一位神君境与半步神灭境战斗，神君境之人居然丝毫不落于下风。

半步神灭，那是半只脚踏入神境的存在啊。

任何一位玄者都是要对半步神灭产生恭敬的。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

“能解决吗？”

Yun Che asked this question to Qianye Ying'er.

Qianye Ying'er said nothing, holding a black mysterious light.

Black mysterious light struck the bodies of those men one after another.

那些男子在这一道道黑色玄光击打下，纷纷的倒退。

When the elders of the Ye family saw this scene, they were all a little shocked.

They couldn't understand how far Qianye Ying'er's power had reached.

Qianye Ying'er was only at the tenth level of the Divine Lord Realm, but she was able to defeat these Divine Lord Realm people to such an extent under the siege of so many Divine Lord Realms.

It would have been impossible for them to do this.

Yun Che nodded gently, and Qianye Ying'er must not use the golden Brahma light in the abyss.

Qianye Ying'er could only use dark profound power, which also led to a significant reduction in her strength.

However, she has the blood of the Heaven Smiting Demon in her body, and she is many times more powerful than the Dark Mysterious Master when it comes to using the Dark Mysterious Power.

Even if she can't use Brahma Light, she still has considerable strength.

"This..."

Yan Song made a shocked sound, and his eyes straightened at this time.

He never expected that Qianye Ying'er's strength could reach such an extent.

“神君境。”

Yan Song quickly withdrew his gaze and looked at Yun Che.

Yun Che is just a Divine Lord. He will first deal with Yun Che, a person in the Divine Lord realm, and then deal with Qianye Ying'er.

"Coming."

The corners of Yun Che's mouth raised slightly, and soon disappeared. It was an arc that Yan Song could not detect.

Yan Song looked at Yun Che and clawed at him:

"Today, I will take your life first."

Yun Che turned on the King of Hell, took out the Heaven-Jieting Demon-Slaying Sword, and gently slashed out the Heaven-Jieting Demon-Slaying Sword.

Yan Song's palm touched the Heaven Smiting Demon Slaying Sword.

Streams of flaming light poured out from his palms and shot towards Yun Che.

Yun Che used the dark profound force, and the dark profound force enveloped him. The moment the flames came into contact with the dark profound force, he was almost mercilessly swallowed by the dark profound force.

叶青：？??

He kept looking at Yun Che. Facing Yun Che's burst of powerful power, he could only say two words to Yun Che:

A person in the Divine Sovereign Realm fights against a half-step God-Destruction Realm, but the person in the Divine Sovereign Realm is not at a disadvantage at all.

Half-step to annihilation of gods, that is the existence of half-step into the realm of gods.

Any profound practitioner must respect Half-Step Divine Destruction.
